paper_title: Can LLMs Solve longer Math Word Problems Better
caption: : GPT-4o-mini
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the informativeness scores for two methods, 0-CoT and CoRe, as they vary across a range of values on the x-axis, which spans from 0 to 4. The y-axis, labeled "Informativeness," ranges from 0.920 to 0.950. The 0-CoT method, represented by a blue dashed line with circular markers, begins at an informativeness score of approximately 0.952 at x=0, decreases to about 0.940 at x=2, and continues to decline to roughly 0.920 at x=4. The CoRe method, shown as an orange solid line with triangular markers, starts at a slightly lower informativeness of about 0.950 at x=0, drops to approximately 0.938 at x=2, and further decreases to around 0.920 at x=4. Both methods exhibit a downward trend in informativeness as the x-axis value increases, with the CoRe method consistently showing a slightly lower informativeness score than 0-CoT across all measured points.
